items.title: How do I self-host a good-looking AI generated website
items.summary: I'm happy to use a service, but most come with hosting plans, and I just want the code so I can host it on my own website. I'm a long-term software developer of the type that isn't good at UI/UX (i.e. scroll bars are the devil, and the mouse isn't much better). I'm soon to do UI as part of my masters degree as part of my redemption arc, but I need something in the meantime, and I'm trying to be efficient with my search :) Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49281976 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
